toolCall.name: post_status
toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"We observed 14 OOM kills in the media namespace in the last hour, primarily affecting the thumbnailer service. The thumbnailer memory usage ratio reached near 100%, causing the OOM kills. We have restarted the thumbnailer service to clear its state and mitigate the issue. Further investigation and resource adjustment may be needed."}

response.text: The alert indicated 14 OOM kills in the media namespace in the last hour. Logs showed the thumbnailer service was OOM killed and restarted by kubelet. The thumbnailer memory usage ratio reached near 100%, confirming memory exhaustion. I restarted the thumbnailer service to clear its state and mitigate the issue. A public status update was posted to inform customers of the incident and remediation. Further investigation and resource adjustment for the thumbnailer service is recommended.
